findings.fix: Either change fixer to use eqx.partition per spec §3.16, OR add a deviation note + tighten reviewer to assert the chosen approach.

findings.issue: test_rank_non_zero_does_not_call_save_fn crashes (exit 138) when run in isolation: rank=1 skips signal registration, so SIGTERM uses the default OS handler which terminates the process. Test passes in the full suite only because a prior test left a Python SIGTERM handler installed — order-dependent false positive.
findings.fix: Save and restore the default signal handlers in a fixture, OR install SIG_IGN before sending signals in the rank=1 test, OR use a subprocess or signal.pthread_kill approach. Simplest: add a pytest fixture that installs SIG_IGN for SIGUSR1/SIGTERM before the rank=1 test and restores them after.

notes: All 7 preemption tests pass. Ruff clean.
